However, "secondary" in this medical context implies the overactivity is a reaction to something else (like low calcium), not that it is the "second" gland. The glossary definition "of less than primary importance" is also not a good fit for the medical meaning. The most accurate plain English translation for "secondary hyperparathyroidism" based on the provided glossary is "overactivity of the parathyroid gland" or "gland working too hard". The word "secondary" is often dropped in plain language summaries if it doesn't add clarity, or replaced with "caused by..." if the cause is known.

attributions.definition: A prostatectomy is a surgery to remove part or all of the prostate and some surrounding tissue.

Surgery to remove part or all of the prostate and some of the tissue around it, including the seminal vesicles (a gland that helps make semen). Nearby lymph nodes may also be removed. A prostatectomy may be done through an incision (cut) made in the wall of the lower abdomen or in the perineum (the area between the scrotum and anus). It may also be done using a laparoscope (a thin, tube-like instrument with a light and lens for viewing) or a special robotic system. An attempt is made to protect the nerves that control penile erection and the bladder from damage.

Energy released in the form of particle or electromagnetic waves. Common sources of radiation include radon gas, cosmic rays from outer space, medical x-rays, and energy given off by a radioisotope (unstable form of a chemical element that releases radiation as it breaks down and becomes more stable). Radiation can damage cells. It is used to diagnose and treat some types of cancer.

sources.text: prostatectomy: Surgery to remove part or all of the prostate and some of the tissue around it, including the seminal vesicles (a gland that helps make semen). Nearby lymph nodes may also be removed. A prostatectomy may be done through an incision (cut) made in the wall of the lower abdomen or in the perineum (the area between the scrotum and anus). It may also be done using a laparoscope (a thin, tube-like instrument with a light and lens for viewing) or a special robotic system. An attempt is made to protect the nerves that control penile erection and the bladder from damage.

attributions.definition: A medication that lowers the body's immune response and inflammation.
A medication that helps lower the body's immune system reactions.

A drug used to reduce inflammation and lower the body’s immune response.  It is used with other drugs to treat leukemia, lymphoma, and mycosis fungoides (a type of skin lymphoma).    It is also used alone or with other drugs to prevent or treat many other conditions.  These include conditions related to cancer and its treatment, such as anemia (a low level of red blood cells) and allergic reactions. Prednisone is a type of therapeutic glucocorticoid.

Phrase frequency rises from 3.00 to 3.24, and age of acquisition drops from 12.29 to 8.10. Patients can now recognize the physical sign without needing to know the specific medical condition.

rationale.text: The original term "unremarkable" means showing no special features or being ordinary, so "normal" conveys that standard state in plain words. Phrase frequency rises from Zipf 2.83 to 5.01, while age of acquisition drops from 11.06 to 5.53. Readers can now recognize that the medical finding is standard without needing to parse a complex adjective.
